why: Chained cluster mixes two pre-fight columns, the fight-day live-stream page, event-wide card results, the Donchenko result reports and a next-day analysis column.

substories.description: Sport.ua 4 Sep journalist preview 'the hardest fight for Donchenko' (same page captured twice) plus the 112.ua rewrite citing it
Sport.ua 5 Sep second pre-fight column 'Donchenko on the UFC main card: big challenge, dangerous opponent' (different author/piece from the 4 Sep preview)
Sport.ua fight-day 'watch online LIVE' page for Donchenko vs Soriano (two captures) plus the 112.ua schedule announcement (Accor Arena, 23:00 Kyiv, main card) rewritten from it
Event-wide UFC Paris results / live-blog pages for the whole Hooker vs Parnasse card, where the Donchenko bout is one line among many
Fight result: Donchenko beats Soriano by unanimous decision (30-27, 30-27, 29-28) at UFC Fight Night 287 in Paris, 4th UFC win, incl. Rodriguez call-out mention; all outlets and languages
Sport.ua 7 Sep next-day analysis column: Donchenko dominated but could have done better, no KO; top-15 and five-round questions
